name: one4wall
description: Search One4Wall's catalog of original phone wallpapers by mood, subject or color, preview them in a gallery and download them in full resolution.

interface.longDescription:
One4Wall brings a catalog of original phone wallpapers into ChatGPT. Describe what you want, such as a mood, a subject or a color, and ChatGPT shows matching wallpapers as a gallery. Tap one to see it large, download it in full resolution, or open it on one4wall.app.

Things you can ask:
- Find a cozy rainy city wallpaper for my phone
- Show me pastel flower wallpapers
- I want a dark minimal mountain lock screen
- Something blue and calm with the ocean

Every wallpaper is made by One4Studio for portrait phone screens. The gallery shows up to eight results at a time; ask again with different words to see more.
capabilities: Search wallpapers by mood, subject or color
Preview matching wallpapers in a gallery
defaultPrompt: Find a cozy rainy city wallpaper for my phone
I want a dark minimal mountain lock screen

positive.description: With One4Wall selected in ChatGPT: A mood and subject request shows a gallery of matching wallpapers.
positive.prompt: Find a cozy rainy city wallpaper for my phone
positive.expected_behavior: A gallery of up to eight wallpapers of rainy cities at night appears. Tapping one shows it large with Download and Open in One4Wall buttons.

positive.description: With One4Wall selected in ChatGPT: A style and subject request.
positive.expected_behavior: A gallery of pastel flower wallpapers appears, with titles under each thumbnail.

positive.description: With One4Wall selected in ChatGPT: A lock screen request with several descriptive words.
positive.prompt: I want a dark minimal mountain lock screen
positive.expected_behavior: A gallery of dark, minimal mountain wallpapers appears; the closest matches come first.

positive.description: With One4Wall selected in ChatGPT: A color is passed as a filter.
positive.prompt: Find me a blue wallpaper with the ocean
positive.expected_behavior: A gallery of ocean wallpapers in blue tones appears.

positive.description: With One4Wall selected in ChatGPT: A specific wallpaper is shown again by its id.
positive.prompt: Show me One4Wall wallpaper 12692 again so I can download it
positive.expected_behavior: The detail view of 'Rainy City Night' appears with a large preview and a Download button. On ChatGPT web, Download opens the full-resolution CDN image so the user can save it; no login or payment is required.

negative.description: A writing request unrelated to wallpapers.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn

negative.description: A request to create a new image, which the plugin does not do (it only searches an existing catalog).
negative.prompt: Generate a brand-new picture of my dog in space

negative.description: A factual question unrelated to wallpapers.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: search One4Wall's phone wallpapers by mood, subject or color, preview them in a gallery and download them in full resolution.
